sections.description:
A new patch is now live on Windows PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes.

To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: - Turrets no longer target barriers directly, but will still target enemies behind them

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that caused visual effects to be absorbed into surfaces

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body:
- Fixed a bug that caused turrets to target Brigitte’s Barrier Shield while facing them when the shield wasn’t deployed
- Fixed a bug that allowed Reaper to reach unintended locations
